content: अभिक्रम् €1 <ab>U.</ab> €4 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To step or go near to approach; तमभिक्रम्य सर्वेऽद्य वयं चार्थामहे वसु <ls>Mb.</ls> .²2 To roam over, wander, pass or walk over. .²3 To attack, assail, fall upon. .²4 To undertake, begin; to set about, prepare; गमनायाभिचक्राम <ls>Rām.</ls> --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To bring near.
